questions.question_text: Why is citation important in academic writing, as discussed in the chapter?

options.text: It helps you avoid doing your own research for assignments
It prevents plagiarism and builds credibility for your work
It makes your project look longer without adding content
It is only necessary for college students, not high schoolers

correct_answer.text: It prevents plagiarism and builds credibility for your work

questions.question_text: Which citation style is most commonly used for English and humanities subjects like literature, according to the chapter?
How would you cite a website in MLA style for a project on “Indian Street Foods under ₹100,” based on the chapter’s guidance?

options.text: Author. “Title of Page.”Website Name, Day Month Year, URL.
Website Name, “Title of Page,” Author, Year.
URL, Author, “Title of Page,” Day Month Year.

correct_answer.text: Author. “Title of Page.”Website Name, Day Month Year, URL.

questions.question_text: What is a key tip for using citation generators responsibly, as explained in the chapter?

options.text: Rely on the tool completely without checking the output
Use only paid versions of citation tools for accuracy
Double-check the generated citation for errors or missing details
Avoid using citation generators since they are always inaccurate

correct_answer.text: Double-check the generated citation for errors or missing details
